[{"insert":"Strict Bar Dip

The strict bar dip is the primary tricep and chest pressing movement of this cycle on Fridays. Keep the elbows tracking back rather than flaring wide to protect the shoulder and keep the load where it belongs. The 31X1 tempo means three seconds down, one second pause at the bottom, then drive. Use assistance as needed to hit the prescribed reps at the prescribed tempo. Reps are consistent across the first three sets with a max unbroken drop set at the end.
"}]
